price_basis: Vendor OHLC/volume basis at v81, including post-2024 actions. Preserve final vendor Adjusted Close anchor. Rebuild AVGO cash dividends; remove duplicate DHR/Fortive cash factor while retaining vendor equivalent conversion; value JCI/Adient distribution at first regular-way close (45.51/10). limitations: Static end-of-period constituent selection; survivorship bias; not historical S&P 500 membership
Capitalization snapshot has no explicit per-company valuation date
Calendar checked against frozen source dates, not official exchange calendar
Do not combine source prices with SEC EPS without matching share basis.
Reviewed AVGO, DHR and JCI actions follow documented price-index conventions. This does not independently certify every corporate action or price in the catalogue.

AVGO.note: Use 39 verified ordinary cash dividends; retain final source Adj Close to preserve later adjustments. Correct duplicated March/June 2018 distributions.

DHR.note: Price-index convention: preserve Yahoo OHLC conversion 1319:1000 already embedded in Close and remove the separately recorded 24.56 cash factor. Primary 2016 10-K corroborates an approximately 1.32 equity-award adjustment and the issuer confirms a 1-for-2 Fortive distribution. The vendor conversion is an equivalent price basis, not an actual increase in DHR shares. Not a portfolio total-return reconstruction.

benchmark.note: Issuer-authored 2016 annual report, stock performance graph, year-end values rounded to two decimals. A rounded annual cross-check, not proof of every daily investor return.

JCI.note: Replace the unverified vendor 4.70 estimate with a documented convention: 45.51 first regular-way ADNT closing price (2016 10-K Item 5) times 1/10 distribution ratio = 4.551 per JCI share. Back-adjust strictly before ex-date using (previous Close - cash equivalent)/previous Close. This is a stock distribution valued for the price index, not cash received or a tax-basis allocation. Preserve source OHLC, all other factors and the final vendor anchor.
